'''Andrew Larkin''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[June 2002 Nostalgia Booster Draft]] in June 2002 with Death Star Command Room draft deck (Arica, Vader, Emperor), according to Brian Matthews's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3732">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-06-12-the-card-board-box-being-placed-oopd3732/ the-card-board-box-being-placed-oop], DeckTech (brian "Sith_Pimp" matthews, 12 June 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-06-12-the-card-board-box-being-placed-oopd3732/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
